rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 4 June 1991, Shri S. B. Chavan (Maharashtra), on whether enough security was provided to the former Prime Minister and leader of the biggest group in Parliament, says 'He was the Congress President', so adequate security should have been provided; the same speech names Mr. Rajiv Gandhi.

locator.item: SHRI S. B. CHAVAN (Maharashtra), opening paragraph

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Replying on 4 June 1991, Shri Chandra Shekhar says a suggestion about the inquiry commission's terms of reference 'has been made by the Congress President to me', that he has received a letter from him and will amend the terms 'When he comes back'; later he says that the day he had a letter 'from the President of the Congress Party' he replied within an hour. The Congress President is not named.

locator.item: SHRI CHANDRA SHEKHAR, paragraph beginning 'About the terms of reference', and his later reply
